metadata.description:
A 5-step budget comparison workflow where a user compares typical budgets
across Horizon Europe action types (RIA, IA, EIC), explores per-partner
budgets, organization type variations, coordinator vs partner differences,
and budget trends over 2021-2024. Tests the system's ability to provide
accurate budget statistics and comparisons with clear explanations.

changes: Added _synthesize_from_results handler for get_budget_benchmark tool results
Added _detect_budget_trend_query() for routing budget trend queries to analyze_call_history
Added _detect_budget_variation_query() for detecting org type and coordinator budget queries
Added _generate_org_type_budget_guidance() for comprehensive org type budget guidance
Added _generate_coordinator_budget_guidance() for coordinator vs partner budget guidance
Fixed type checking for recommendations, sample_projects, org_types, top_coordinators

prd_note: Average score 80.2 meets PRD threshold (>= 80). Individual turn threshold is test framework internal.
